source: Make a Constert Stage game with Bulit in music to use and house lights

image_prompt.text: The concert stage itself as the hero build - a raised performance platform composed to be framed from the floor
Arrival placed at the back of the floor facing the stage, so the first thing a visitor sees is the lit stage
An open audience floor in front of the stage for the crowd to gather in
House lights - trusses, spotlights and colour washes rigged over the stage and out across the audience
Built-in music equipment on the stage: speaker stacks, monitors and instruments

layout_placement.text: Spawn point oriented at the stage
Small optional finds tucked around the venue off the main floor

notes: The built-in music is audio content with no layout footprint; the equipment that plays it is drawn, the tracks are not ours.
House lights are lighting behaviour - the trusses and fixtures can be drawn, the colour and movement cannot travel in this handoff.
Preset caveat: Free-Roam Showcase brings hidden collectibles, which a concert venue did not ask for.

open_questions.ask: Indoor club, arena, or an outdoor festival stage?
Do players perform on the stage themselves, or is it a venue to watch in?

coverage_missing.ask: Indoor club, arena, or outdoor festival?
Is there backstage and a green room, or just stage and floor?

answers.ask: Indoor club, arena, or an outdoor festival stage?
answers.answer: Make it an indoor club concert stage with house lights.

answers.ask: Do players perform on the stage themselves, or is it a venue to watch in?
answers.answer: Players should be able to perform on the stage themselves using the built-in music.
